lines.rom: arati gajabadana vinayaka ki sura muni pujita gananayaka ki
ekadanta sasibhala gajanana vighnavinasaka subhaguna kanana sivasuta vandyamana caturanana duhkhavinasaka sukhadayaka ki
rddhi siddhi svami samartha ati vimala buddhi data suvimala mati agha vana dahana amala abigata gati vidya vinaya vibhava dayaka ki
